description: This file defines API routes related to weather and location data, including location search, current weather, and forecast retrieval, using FastAPI framework. It interacts with external services like OpenStreetMap Nominatim and Open-Meteo to fetch geocoding and weather data.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] search_location( q: str = Query(..., description="Free-form location query, e.g., 'San Francisco'"), limit: int = Query(5, ge=1, le=10, description="Maximum number of results"), )
methods.description: Searches for locations using OpenStreetMap Nominatim and returns raw results.

methods.name: WeatherSnapshot get_current_weather( location: str = Query(..., description="City or location to query"), )
methods.description: Retrieves current weather data for a specified location by geocoding to coordinates and querying Open-Meteo.

methods.name: List[ForecastItem] get_forecast( location: str = Query(..., description="City or location to query"), hours: int = Query(24, ge=1, le=168, description="Forecast horizon in hours (max 168)"), step_hours: int = Query(6, ge=1, le=24, description="Sampling interval in hours"), )
methods.description: Fetches weather forecast data for a location over a specified horizon and sample interval.
